title: How to play Minecraft
text: Minecraft is a game about blocks. Everything in the world is a block: the grass, the trees, the stone and even the water. You can break blocks and you can build with them.
When you start, you are in a big world. First, find a tree and break it. You get wood. With wood you can make a table, a pickaxe and many other things.
Be careful when the sun goes down! At night, monsters come out: zombies, skeletons and creepers. Build a small house before the night and stay inside.
Look for coal and iron in the caves. With iron you can make better tools. Do not dig straight down: you can fall into a hole or into lava!
There are two main modes. In Survival mode you need food and you can die. In Creative mode you can fly and you have all the blocks. Choose your mode and have fun!

grammar.title: Grammar: imperatives
grammar.rule: Use the imperative to give instructions. It is the verb with no subject. For a negative, use do not + verb.
